b'# tinydl

A tiny command-line HTTP downloader. It fetches a URL and writes the result to
a file or to standard output.

## Usage

```
python -m app.cli URL [options]
```

`URL` is the address to download.

## Command line options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `url` | positional argument \xe2\x80\x94 what to download |
| `-o`, `--output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | no progress output |

## Example

```
python -m app.cli https://example.com/file.bin -o file.bin
```
'
